description: A namespaced call doesn't call a function declared with the name alone
notes: The spec has no namespaced function names, so ns::f() would be a syntax error. hashicorp/hcl parses the call (finishParsingFunctionCall in hclsyntax/parser.go) and looks up the name joined with :: in the function table (FunctionCallExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go), so a function named f doesn't match.
reference_error: There are no functions in namespace "ns::"
